name: T3 Code
description: Experimental Codex chat integration through an existing official T3 Code installation and your existing Codex login. The crawl targets Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64, with approvals deferred; Windows is unsupported. This Phase A shell reports prerequisites and refuses turns until its runtime is implemented.

tools.name: minerva_t3_code_generate
tools.description: Generate or resume a Codex turn for a bound Minerva chat. Phase A refuses with a visible setup/runtime-not-started error and never submits a prompt.

operation_token.description: Host-owned turn identity, reused on resume and cancel.

text.description: Newest user message; native thread owns prior context.

tools.name: minerva_t3_code_cancel
tools.description: Interrupt the exact operation bound to this chat. Phase A reports not-started because no backend run exists.

operation_token.description: Host-owned turn identity, reused on resume and cancel.

tools.name: minerva_t3_code_status
tools.description: Read prerequisite diagnostics and the authoritative compatibility tuple. Returns thread_id/run_id empty and state not-started before any runtime turn; no bearer is exposed.

settings.label: Existing native T3 executable
settings.help: Completed official T3 v0.1.6 CLI installation only. Phase A reads the native executable header and adjacent .install-complete marker; it never runs T3 or its npm/installer launcher. If PATH t3 is a script, select the existing runtime/versions/0.1.6/t3 binary. No download, patch or upgrade.

settings.label: Node executable
settings.help: T3 requires ^22.16 || ^23.11 || >=24.10. The owner chooses any installation or upgrade.

settings.label: Codex executable
settings.help: Use the existing Codex CLI and login. No API key or billing-mode change is performed.

settings.label: Codex home
settings.help: The owner-approved existing login is used in place. Credentials are never copied, moved or deleted.

settings.label: Private T3 base directory
settings.help: Private T3 state is retained here: database, provider logs, attachments and checkpoints. {private} resolves to this plugin's per-user data directory; {workspace} is the saved Minerva project folder.

settings.label: Private MCP bearer file
settings.help: Phase B stores an owned mcp-client bearer privately with mode 0600. Store only its path here. Public CLI issuance has an approval-required ceiling and explicit expiry; revocation is owned by the runtime.

settings.label: Minerva MCP endpoint
settings.help: The authorized Minerva MCP URL used by native Codex. {minerva_mcp} in other settings expands to this value. No Core or UGS connection is used. Supported tuple: plugin 0.1.0 / T3 v0.1.6 / Codex existing login in place / project-default mode, approval-required client ceiling. Detected tuple is authoritative in minerva_t3_code_status.
